svg.title: Geometry alongside instability and the neuron's actual output

cc:Work.dc:title: Geometry alongside instability and the neuron's actual output
cc:Work.dc:description: Three maps use identical alpha and gamma coordinates. The first is categorical peak period, the second is finite-time Lyapunov exponent, and the third is standard deviation of tanh(x3). Their alignment exposes whether periodic geometry coincides with changes in measured neural activity. Missing measurements are masked.
